qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the plug in rear casing section on all transmission types?
What torque should be applied to the sealing caps on rear case section for 240/260/280 transmissions?
What is the torque specification for clamping claws to rear case section?
qa_pairs.answer: 33 Nm for ZF S-5-16/5 5 D 310 Z transmissions

qa_pairs.question: What torque should be applied to screws on detent plate?
qa_pairs.answer: 9 Nm for ZF S-5-16/5 5 D 310 Z transmissions

qa_pairs.question: Which transmission type uses M16 screws with 40 Nm torque for the plug in rear casing section?
Which components in this section require the lowest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: Screws on detent plate require the lowest torque at 9 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What transmission types use the ZF S-5-16/5 5 D 310 Z designation?
qa_pairs.answer: The reversing bolt to reversing lever, clamping claws to rear case section, and screws on detent plate all use ZF S-5-16/5 5 D 310 Z transmissions

qa_pairs.question: What is the highest torque specification listed in this manual transmission case and covers section?
qa_pairs.answer: 60 Nm, which is used for both the M20 screw (all types) and M22 screw (260/280) for the plug in rear casing section
